scope: Observable behavior and presentation in the local Three.js and Kaigen source snapshots; engine algorithms may differ.
status_policy: Existing test files are coverage, not proof of a current pass. Pending and unavailable evidence never pass a parity gate.

threejs.revision: Source archive without Git metadata; lock content hashes instead of guessing a commit.

kaigen.local_capture: unavailable: hz engine dependency/CLI absent from local source archive
kaigen.hosted_status: Page loaded and rendered gameplay in the in-app browser; observational only.
kaigen.hosted_source_match: Unverified: published build cannot be equated with the local source archive.
kaigen.controlled_capture: Unavailable: no verified frame-addressed camera/scene adapter or equivalent laboratory.
kaigen.performance: Unmeasured under the sustained protocol; the hosted FPS overlay is not qualification.

comparison.world_space: Metres, Y up; catalogue cameras are in level space, looking toward target with vertical FOV in degrees.
comparison.seed_policy: Retain each implementation's source default. Equal numeric seeds would not make different RNG/generation algorithms equivalent.
comparison.lighting_policy: Match solar time and record actual world-space sun direction; current world rotations and Defold's 61-degree celestial rotation are not a lighting match.

quality.defold: Medium material tier, high photographic tier, production capture defaults; record all live settings.
quality.threejs: Ultra, with actual preset, framebuffer, renderer and metered exposure recorded per shot.
quality.kaigen: For future controlled captures fix Ultra and record actual settings; hosted automatic quality is observational only.

exposure.defold: Fixed multiplier 1, adaptation disabled by capture controller.
exposure.threejs: 90 lockstep frames, frozen simulation/time, actual GPU exposure readback and display multiplier recorded.
exposure.kaigen: Unknown until a controlled capture adapter is available.
exposure.equivalence: Unmatched exposure models: compare appearance, never infer equal radiance from equal multipliers.

comparison.repeatability: Fresh reference page per shot/repeat. Exact pixels only within matching backend, source, scene, camera, frame and settings.
comparison.laboratory: Export production Defold triangles into the Three.js level transform, with reference procedural recipes and uniform roughness spheres. Special glass/cutout/light fixtures remain pending.
comparison.cross_engine_gate: Human review of composition, material separation, contrast, colour and motion; no cross-engine pixel-equality score.

performance.status: User-selected Mac native and desktop browser at 60 FPS; other budgets are proposed engineering thresholds, not measurements.
performance.device_decision: 2026-10-15: Mac + desktop browser only, target 60 FPS. Mobile qualification is outside the current acceptance gate.

protocol.build: Release; report engine/browser/OS/GPU, device, preset, native framebuffer and internal resolution.
protocol.scenario: Continuous full-map traversal with six AI, firing/reloads, indoors/outdoors, grenades and settled/live ragdolls. Until those features exist, mark the full-load budget unqualified.
protocol.cold_load: Fresh process and generated resources; exclude download time from local generation and report network transfer separately.
protocol.frame_metric: Wall-clock presented-frame intervals; report p50/p95/p99/worst, CPU/GPU separately and dropped/disjoint samples.
protocol.memory_metric: Measured peak process resident memory plus separately reported GPU/resource estimates; estimates are not resident-memory measurements.
protocol.regression: No shader compilations during measured play; no monotonic live-resource growth across ten encounter resets.

devices.device: Available MacBook Pro, Apple M3 Pro, 18 GB

devices.availability: available; renderer-process memory scope must be recorded

adaptations.current: Full market with source-derived setbacks, balconies, recessed windows, damaged W3/E3 floors, gate and all dressing families. E1 shop/storage and E3 ruin/storage are furnished. W2 keeps its validated stairs and gains the 2.4 m setback, with adjusted upstairs furniture and an additional ground-floor hall opening. E2 retains its extra three-floor interior. Selected props shift to preserve the standing routes; infill arcades and flat terrain/boundary walls remain Defold adaptations. Room partitions, simplified collision envelopes and reduced decorative tessellation differ from the references.
adaptations.reference: Full authored market including E1/E3 interiors

adaptations.current: Collision-limited eye origin retained. Every travelled segment tests cover, including before a visual muzzle protruding through a wall. Muzzle-only overlap does not block a clear eye ray; the interpolated viewmodel never determines projectile origin or collision.

Reference scales: head 4x, chest 1x, lower torso .9x, arms .65x, legs .7x. Eleven bone-driven oriented boxes, with separate upper-arm/forearm segments, replace reference capsule proxies. First region hit applies damage once per actor per round.
1–3 inspection, 6–8 weapons, F inspect, held crouch/prone
adaptations.reference: 1–3 weapons, I inspect, wheel switch, toggle crouch/prone

adaptations.current: RGBA16F qualified on Metal; encoded RGBA8 elsewhere

adaptations.reference: GPU metering with different lighting/radiometric scales

adaptations.current: 24 logical / 72 physical voices with synchronized dry, muffled and sparse wet PCM; four continuous two-height emitter probes per frame, room blends, ducking and concussion. No HRTF or full convolution; proposed equivalent still requires listening acceptance.
Swept up/across/down paths revalidated every tick; deep ledges require Jump. Low thin obstacles vault automatically at speed.
adaptations.reference: Rooted curves after initial clearance validation; low deep ledges may also trigger automatically.

adaptations.current: Analytic fixed-tick springs with interpolated outputs; deterministic sine shake; final mantle pitch settles before completion.
adaptations.reference: Numerically substepped springs, noise shake and a final rooted mantle pitch offset.

adaptations.reason: Uses the existing engine solver and geometry without a second physics world or native extension. Box contacts and limited collision pairs bound cost; explicit articulation sleep prevents residual constraint contacts from keeping corpses active.
adaptations.current: Use native Bullet boxes with pose-centred cone-twist constraints and explicit group sleep. Keep physics at 120 Hz, bounded body pools, world-only collision masks, interpolated skeleton/shadows and physical corpse hit reactions without health damage. The carried gun follows the right hand; detached weapons and body-body collision are outside this increment.
adaptations.reference: Three.js uses position-based capsule ragdolls and probe-based rigid debris. Kaigen uses native capsule bodies. Equivalent motion remains a visual qualification gate.

adaptations.current: Left-hand windup, elevation-corrected lob, conservative 20-segment sphere clearance and nearby-ally rejection, .02 linear Bullet damping and no prop-to-prop collisions. Basic nearest-danger text instead of projected markers; compact generated explosion audio/FX reuse bounded pools. Reference cooldown, inventory, fuse, radius and damage/falloff rules retained; presentation and sustained cost remain unqualified.
adaptations.reference: Three.js ai/agent.js, ai/squad.js and ai/index.js; Kaigen cod_ai_brain.c, cod_ai_squad.c and cod_weapons_grenade.c.

scenarios.procedure: Capture catalogue stills twice from fresh runs at the recorded camera, seed, solar time and quality; review identical-scene motion sweeps.
scenarios.expect: Within-backend repeats agree; every cross-engine image records actual settings and unsupported scenes remain pending.

scenarios.procedure: Traverse every street/flank/doorway/stair/floor and route six actors between all connected areas.
scenarios.expect: Reference entrances, cover and sightlines exist; no invalid floor links or geometry/collision disagreements.

scenarios.procedure: Compare street, courtyard, gate, ruined building and furnished-room compositions.
scenarios.expect: Reference silhouette, content density and traversable openings are present.

scenarios.feature: All surface recipes, weathering and filtering
scenarios.procedure: Inspect every recipe close up, at distance and grazing angles; sweep lit/shaded roughness rows.
scenarios.expect: Full catalogue including sand/corrugated/burlap/foliage, stable relief and no seams or cutout shimmer.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Nineteen runtime recipes, all three atlas tiers, shared leaf coverage in colour/depth/motion/sun/local shadows. Foliage uses world-projected two-sided cards and filtered distant coverage; matched reference UV/coverage and visual qualification remain open.

scenarios.procedure: Run stairs/slopes/low ceilings, sprint/slide/jump, mantle thick ledges and vault thin obstacles with blocked and clear landings.
scenarios.expect: Reference movement timing with no clipping, unsupported landings or frame-rate-dependent travel.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Automatic low thin-obstacle vaults, explicit high vaults and deep-ledge mantles. Clear landing and swept path checks before and during traversal; support rechecked on completion. AI local vault links now reuse these swept low-obstacle checks in step 11. Cross-engine motion review remains open.

scenarios.procedure: Record walking, sprint/ADS transitions, strafe/turn, land, slide, mantle and damage sequences.
scenarios.expect: Reference spring timing and additive motion without camera collision violations.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Fixed-tick, interpolated footfall bob, landing/step springs, angular kick residuals, strafe/turn banking, breathing, slide/mantle/vault offsets and movement/ADS FOV. Collision-limited eye and aim shared with firing; damage events and explicit suppression/explosion channels. Player suppression detection is implemented by the health increment; grenade damage is connected by step 12. Controlled reference motion comparison is still open.

scenarios.feature: Damage, regeneration, falls and player suppression
scenarios.procedure: Take timed hits, wait for recovery, fall from known heights and receive near misses; repeat with pause and death.
scenarios.expect: Delayed ramped regeneration, appropriate fall damage and suppression; no healing dead actors or duplicate damage.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Fixed-tick 4.6 s regeneration delay, .55 s ramp to 34 HP/s, fall damage above 15 m/s at 7 HP/(m/s), real-segment/impact/hit suppression with cover and per-round maximum contributions, source-origin directional impulses, low-health desaturation/pulse and recovery/heartbeat events. Explosion notifications provide feedback; the step-12 grenade owner queues obstruction-aware damage separately. Heartbeat audio is connected in step 15. Uses the existing composite before AgX and after temporal resolve, without exposure-meter feedback. Native/WebGL shared fixtures pass; controlled reference visual comparison remains open.

scenarios.feature: Three weapons, fire modes and ammunition
scenarios.procedure: Fire each mode, reload tactical/empty, interrupt before/after mag transfer, switch and inspect at 30/60/144 presentation FPS.
scenarios.expect: Matching rates, chambers, ammunition transfers and interruption rules; correct requested weapon in capture.

scenarios.procedure: Capture every weapon hip/ADS/reload/inspect indoors and outdoors, plus camera turns and walking.
scenarios.expect: Reference silhouettes and hand grips; aligned optics and lag/sway without broken joints.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Source-scale bounded weapon assemblies, shared 17-joint arms, body-fixed shoulder IK, finger poses, magazine/charge hand tracks and fixed-tick follow/sway/footfall motion. Full ADS and collimated dot constrained to the camera axis; tactical/empty transfers and interruptions preserved. Native/release WebGL shared fixtures pass. Reduced geometry, bounded sleeve length correction, material/detail matching, reference motion and controlled Kaigen comparisons remain explicit qualification limits.

scenarios.procedure: Shoot bare targets, thin wood, thick concrete, overlapping layers and a muzzle-obstructing wall with fixed seeds.
scenarios.expect: Reference attenuation/deflection, complete travelled-segment checks and documented origin behavior.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Reference material depths/loss/scatter and unchanged weapon/range tuning. Linear loss uses each layer entry budget, accumulated over actual travel; overlapping solids consume power concurrently. Exit deflection uses private round Gaussian streams and re-queries remaining tick flight with no untested epsilon jump. Quadratic range falloff is applied once to travelled distance. Eye-origin rule is documented and production firing/penetration/pause/reset fixtures pass on native and release WebGL. Exact reference RNG sequences, proxy geometry and sustained cost remain explicit differences/qualification limits.

scenarios.procedure: Hit head, upper/lower torso, arms and legs while actors move and crouch.
scenarios.expect: Reference regional scales and correct skeleton-driven volumes; one damage application per actor per round.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Eleven bone-driven oriented boxes: head 4x, chest 1x, hips .9x, upper arms/forearms .65x, thighs/shins .7x. First hit region owns one damage request per actor/round; region and part survive damage/death events. Immediate Bullet queries refresh broadphase after pose setters. Native and release-WebGL fixtures verify all eleven volumes in three poses, lethal headshot and bounded reset counts. Box versus reference capsule coverage and controlled reference comparisons remain documented qualifications.

scenarios.procedure: Show all variants walking/running/crouching/turning on stairs, aiming, reloading, vaulting and reacting to hits.
scenarios.expect: Reference equipment/anatomy, grounded feet, attached hands, matching shadows and motion vectors.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Three shared variant meshes, source height/bulk and distinct gear/carbine/AK recipes. Fixed-tick run/crouch, turning, wounded/regional-hit, reload and vault layers; two ground probes, world stance anchors, pelvis/sole correction and rigid leg/hand IK. Same evaluator drives scaled Bullet volumes and current/previous render palettes. Physics joint frames reconstruct the animated skeleton. Step 11 supplies reload ammunition cycles and local AI vault routing; step 10 supplies native Bullet ragdolls. Native/release-WebGL fixtures exercise posed volumes, uneven terrain, live stairs, pause and bounded resets. Reduced geometry/detail, static contacts and analytic poses are adaptations; reference appearance/motion and sustained cost remain open.

scenarios.procedure: Kill actors on floors/stairs/beside walls; fire/reload repeatedly; apply blast impulses and reset ten times.
scenarios.expect: Stable physical settling and impulses, bounded lifetime/sleep/resource counts.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Native Bullet owns 120 Hz integration. Eighteen box bodies and seventeen cone-twist joints inherit the animated pose, root velocity and regional lethal impulse; all 25 visible/shadow/motion bones follow interpolated body transforms. Corpses are ray-queryable but never re-enter health damage. The 32-slot debris pool receives player/enemy shells, reload magdrop and impact notifications. World-occluded blast events wake bodies. Whole-articulation and debris sleep explicitly suspend native simulation after sustained pose stability; impulses restore it. Pause/capture preserve physics state; debris expires after 8/10/18 seconds and corpses after 30. Bodies collide only with static world geometry. Box proxies, pose-centred symmetric angular limits, hand-attached weapons, simplified debris meshes and disabled mutual/live-character collisions are adaptations. Controlled reference motion, full visual parity and sustained performance remain open.

scenarios.feature: Hearing, search, cover, bursts, reload and flank
scenarios.current: implemented; controlled reference comparison and sustained performance remain open
scenarios.procedure: Approach unseen with noise, break visual contact, pin cover, wound an actor, hold position and obstruct a route.
scenarios.expect: No omniscience; investigation/retreat, squad peek permissions, tall-cover peeks, burst/reload cycles and useful flanks.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Evidence snapshots separate visual/squad contact from heard locations. 58 m visual range, delayed acquisition, 90/11/24/120 m shot/walk/run/explosion hearing with 45% occluded reach; hearing never grants a firing target. Bounded search, reachable wounded retreat, 30-round magazines, 3–7-round bursts, source cyclic rates/reload durations, variant damage/spread/speed, actor-scoped reload beats and debris. Tall cover uses capsule-checked side positions; one peek permission per squad rotates and releases. Recent visual suppressive rounds expire after 2.2 seconds and retain muzzle/world/friendly checks. All five authored flank routes and lateral graph positions are available; failed routes release reservations. Local low thin-obstacle vaults reuse swept traversal and animation. Seventeen supported tall-wall candidates extend cover metadata to 42 without new geometry. Graph navigation, ray hearing, one squad permission, unlimited reserve magazines and port combat tuning are adaptations. Native/release-WebGL behavior fixtures and unit checks do not establish controlled source parity or sustained performance.

scenarios.procedure: Trigger squad throws toward exposed and covered targets; pause mid-fuse and restart before detonation.
scenarios.expect: Rationed throws, bounce/fuse, obstruction-aware blast, impulses and synchronized warning/FX/audio.
scenarios.implementation_notes: One frag per enemy, 9–22 s initial actor and 6 s squad cooldowns, 8–26 m fresh-contact decisions and exclusive grants followed by 14–26 s squad cooldowns. Left-hand windup releases at .48 s; copied target, elevation-aware lob, swept arc and ally checks at decision/release. Six dedicated 5 cm / .42 kg Bullet spheres cannot be evicted by debris. Fixed 2.35 s fuse, 6.5 m / 120 damage blast, reference player/AI falloff, reverse world rays for cover/floors and one centralized damage request per actor including thrower. Existing bodies receive visibility-tested impulses; lethal damage carries impulse into ragdolls. Basic direction/height/distance/fuse warning, pressure, generated spatial blast audio and bounded flash/smoke/light are connected. Native and release-WebGL fixtures pass eleven checks and four captures each; 77 synthesized samples match Lua on both. Full reference presentation, sustained combat cost and Kaigen controlled capture remain open.

scenarios.procedure: Fire into each surface, kill actors, detonate grenades, walk/land and inspect smoke, motes and heat haze.
scenarios.expect: Full effect catalogue, correct sorting/receivers and bounded pools during sustained fire.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Twelve procedural surface recipes, swept/dragged visual fragments with bounded bounces, cooling aligned sparks, world-ray blood/scorch receivers and dynamic-body decal rejection. Grenades drive fire, shockwave, smoke columns, debris, existing light and heat refraction; movement/death events drive dust. Three authored wreck sources, camera motes and daytime ground shimmer. Fixed 60 Hz presentation with independent RNG, 128 combat/32 ambient/48 decal/12 haze slots and eight emitters; 220 meshes share a 144-byte quad. Sorted colour transparency follows TAA; Metal uses premultiplied linear HDR, while RGBA8 compands colour with coverage and correlated dithering (encoded-space overlap is approximate). Additive signed offsets use a half-resolution RGBA8 target and reuse resolved radiance for the warp. Native Metal and release WebGL pass 13 shared checks, 15 captures and eight within-backend pixel gates each. Fixed comparison captures disable temporal AA/adaptive photography. Accelerated 60-second pool pressure and three restarts validate bounds, not sustained performance. Reduced counts, procedural masks, point sweeps, clipped planar decals, authored sources and RGBA8 offsets are adaptations. Controlled reference motion/appearance and Kaigen comparison remain open.

scenarios.procedure: Capture fixed day/sunset/night indoors/outdoors, then animate time and cloud cover across a full transition.
scenarios.expect: Consistent light/environment/shadows, moving cloud influence and no stale reflection or temporal trails.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Continuous solar/lunar time with twilight/horizon fade and midnight wrap; independent presentation weather clock drives reference-speed cloud decks, surface cloud shadows and advected volumetric density. Eight sky strips and nine filtered-environment rows build behind a complete displayed pair, at most two update draws per frame, then radiance/direct-light/shadow/weather inputs blend over 0.2 seconds without TAA resets. Explicit seeks publish after 19 updates and reset history; capture, pause and focus freeze clocks. Six staging targets add 12.134 MiB HDR / 6.067 MiB RGBA8; weather occupies the existing lighting constant array. Native Metal and release Chrome WebGL each pass eight checks, 18 captures and 13 pixel gates, including an eight-hour sunset/midnight transition and three restarts. Existing fixed native suite passes eleven exact view returns. The 61-degree map rotation, delayed sampled blending, single shadowed key, approximate scattering/night radiometry and mean-density fog extinction remain adaptations. Aligned reference lighting, controlled Kaigen, GPU cost and sustained 60 FPS qualification remain open.

scenarios.feature: HDR, shadows, AO, TAA, reflections and photography
scenarios.procedure: Run HDR probes and feature on/off/return pixels; inspect thin edges, moving soldiers, glass and ADS with optical effects.
scenarios.expect: Feature contribution, stable history and isolated weapon/GUI; comparable source appearance remains a review gate.

scenarios.procedure: Listen to every weapon/surface, enemy steps/barks, near misses, explosions, heartbeat and UI; repeat indoors/outdoors.
scenarios.expect: Reference timbre and event timing with generated sounds, bounded voices and no stale cues.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Step 15: 234 generated PCM layers / 10,611,456 bytes, 24 logical / 72 physical voices, 64 pending cues with callback-safe priority replacement. Real casing/grenade/body contacts, one-per-travelled-projectile cracks/whizzes, soldier stride/bark observers, heartbeat/confirmations/UI and independent distant battle schedule. Four continuous two-height probes per presentation; 45 ms layer blends, 12 sparse reflection taps, ambience ducking and cover-reduced deafening/tinnitus. Pause freezes scene state; restart retains the bank. HRTF, full five-space convolution, exact timbre, propagation delay and listening acceptance remain open; proposed adaptation is not accepted parity.

scenarios.procedure: Move an audible source behind cover and across room boundaries; combine footsteps, automatic fire and a nearby blast.
scenarios.expect: Continuous obstruction/reverb changes, spatial localization, ducking and concussion without clipping.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Step 15: 234 generated PCM layers / 10,611,456 bytes, 24 logical / 72 physical voices, 64 pending cues with callback-safe priority replacement. Real casing/grenade/body contacts, one-per-travelled-projectile cracks/whizzes, soldier stride/bark observers, heartbeat/confirmations/UI and independent distant battle schedule. Four continuous two-height probes per presentation; 45 ms layer blends, 12 sparse reflection taps, ambience ducking and cover-reduced deafening/tinnitus. Pause freezes scene state; restart retains the bank. HRTF, full five-space convolution, exact timbre, propagation delay and listening acceptance remain open; proposed adaptation is not accepted parity.

scenarios.procedure: Fight and reload, receive hits from several bearings, see offscreen grenades, switch floors and resize/pause/restart.
scenarios.expect: Contacts, damage numbers, kill banners, grenade indicators and readable bounded layouts with correct lifecycle.

scenarios.feature: Mouse, gamepad, touch and user settings
scenarios.procedure: Complete traversal/combat/menu/restart flows separately with each device; change FOV/inversion/presets and return focus.
scenarios.expect: Reference bindings, toggles, defaults and no stuck inputs; actual browser pointer lock and touch/audio activation verified.

scenarios.procedure: Run the specified sustained protocol for every target preset/device; change manual/automatic quality during combat.
scenarios.expect: Recorded budgets, stable adaptation, manual override, no gameplay shader compiles and no resource growth.

scenarios.procedure: Run all scenarios on target devices, inject WebGL context loss, resize, background/resume and repeat quality changes.
scenarios.expect: Generated resources recover; HDR or documented fallback works; full gameplay/input/audio and sustained budgets qualify.

exclusions: Objective game mode inferred from UI hooks
